app.title: Jota | Free music self-hosted service
app.description: Jota is a free, self-hosted music service. Stream your music anywhere, anytime.

common.confirm: Are you sure you want to delete it?

search.title: Search
search.youtubePlaceholder: Search in YouTube (videos, playlists or channels)
search.spotifyPlaceholder: Paste a Spotify {type} link, URI or ID...

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your account and how Jota syncs playback.

discord.title: Discord
discord.description: Show what you're listening to in your Discord status.
discord.label: Discord rich presence

idle.title: Background memory
idle.description: Reload the app after it has been hidden for a while to free cached images. Playback is not affected.
idle.label: Idle reload

logs.title: Logs
logs.description: Share the app log when reporting a problem.

welcome.title: Welcome to Jota
welcome.body: Log in with Spotify to search, play and sync your music.

spotify.prompt: Connect with Spotify to use this.
spotify.completeLogin: Complete Spotify login, then return here.

youtube.signInBody: This track needs a signed-in YouTube account — it is age-restricted or YouTube asked to confirm you are not a bot.
youtube.signInRisk: Risk: using an account this way can get it banned by Google. Prefer a secondary account.
youtube.unavailable: In-app sign-in is not available on this platform. Paste your cookies or import a cookies.txt in Settings → Account.
youtube.errorHint: {error} — you can paste your cookies in Settings → Account instead.
youtube.settingsRisk: Signing in with a Google account and using it to play audio can get that account banned by Google. Use an account you can afford to lose, and prefer a secondary one.
youtube.unavailableShort: In-app sign-in is not available on this platform. Paste your cookies or import a cookies.txt export below.
youtube.pasteHint: On a signed-in youtube.com tab, run copy(document.cookie) in the console and paste it below, or import a cookies.txt export.
youtube.pastePlaceholder: Paste cookies (must include SAPISID) or a cookies.txt export

hint.title: No playlists yet
hint.body: Save a YouTube playlist or create a local one — both show up here.
hint.step1: In the search bar at the top, search a playlist by name or paste its link.
hint.step2: Open the Playlists tab in the results and tap the heart to save it.
hint.step3: Or use the + button to create a local playlist.

queue.title: Queue
queue.emptyHint: Pick a playlist and click a track to start.
queue.snapBelow: Place just below the playing track

track.broken: This song is no longer available at its source.

youtubeId.title: YouTube ID
youtubeId.hint: Jota automatically finds this song's audio on YouTube. If it picked the wrong video, paste the correct video ID here: 11 characters, the part after "v=" in its URL.

following.empty: Nothing here yet. Follow a Spotify profile or a YouTube channel to see it in this list.

hint.title: Nothing to see yet
hint.body: Follow a Spotify profile or a YouTube channel and it will show up here.
hint.step1: In the search bar at the top, search an artist, profile or channel.
hint.step2: Open the profile or channel and tap the heart to follow it.
hint.step3: Spotify profiles and YouTube channels you follow appear on this page.

custom.empty: No playlists yet. Create one and add songs to it.
custom.noPlaylists: No playlists yet. Create one below.

hint.title: No local playlists yet
hint.body: Create a local playlist to collect songs that live on this device.
hint.step1: Tap the + button in the top corner of your playlists.
hint.step2: Name it and it appears in this list.
hint.step3: Open it and add songs from any source.

rooms.empty: No saved rooms. Connect to a room and save it from the Rooms panel.

session.title: Rooms
session.relayRequiredBody: To use this feature you need a relay server. Configure one in Settings to start or join a room.
session.inRoom: You are in room {room}. Edit the code to switch rooms.
session.hostHint: If nobody is hosting it yet, you become the host; otherwise you join and listen in sync.
session.saveTitle: Save this room to the Rooms shelf
session.waiting: Waiting for the room to load…

relay.title: Rooms
relay.body: Relay server that syncs playback between devices. Rooms and their passwords are set from the Rooms panel.
relay.label: Relay server
relay.tokenRequired: This relay requires an auth token.

errors.playbackBlocked: the browser needs a click to allow playback

backend.loginUnavailable: In-app browser login is not available on this platform
backend.installUnsupported: update: automatic install is not supported on this channel
